question: The battle of Haldighati was fought in:
solution:
The correct answer is __**1576**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Battle of Haldighati was fought on June 18, 1576 at Haldighati, a mountain pass in the Aravalli Range of Rajasthan, India: 
 
• The battle was fought between the forces of the Mughal emperor Akbar and the forces of Maharana Pratap, the Rajput ruler of Mewar: 
 
• Maharana Pratap's forces included cavalry and archers, while the Mughal forces were led by Man Singh I of Amber. 
 
• Result
 
• The Mughals technically won the battle, but it was considered indecisive because Maharana Pratap was not captured and he continued to fight. 
 
• The Battle of Haldighati is considered a significant event in the history of the Rajputs.
 
• It is also known for its ambiguous nature, which has left historians to debate the victor.
